description: 区営自転車駐車場一覧 [cycling networks] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 大田区. 【大田区】区営自転車駐車場の一覧です。. Coverage: 大田区. The portal files it under the publisher 大田区. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-07-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
